nodes.description: CTokenStorage.admin: privileged administrator address of the money market
CTokenStorage._notEntered: reentrancy guard flag used by nonReentrant
CTokenStorage.totalBorrows: total outstanding borrows of underlying
CTokenStorage.totalReserves: total reserves of underlying held
CTokenStorage.totalSupply: total number of cTokens in circulation
CTokenStorage.accountTokens: mapping of account to cToken balance
CTokenStorage.accountBorrows: mapping of account to BorrowSnapshot
CTokenStorage.borrowIndex: accumulated interest rate index
CTokenStorage.accrualBlockNumber: block number interest was last accrued
ComptrollerV3Storage.compAccrued: COMP accrued but not yet transferred
ComptrollerV3Storage.compRate: COMP distribution rate per block
ComptrollerV3Storage.miningRule: 0 mints by supply, 1 mints by borrow
CDelegationStorage.implementation: implementation address used by delegatecall
Cheese.balances: token balances of the CHEESE ERC-20
Cheese.allowances: nested allowance mapping of the CHEESE ERC-20
Cheese.nonces: signature replay-protection nonces
UnitrollerAdminStorage.comptrollerImplementation: delegatecall target of Unitroller
CToken.accrueInterest: computes and stores interest, updates borrowIndex/totalBorrows/totalReserves
CToken.transferTokens: internal cToken transfer with allowance and comptroller checks
CToken.mintFresh: mints cTokens after pulling underlying via doTransferIn
CToken.redeemFresh: redeems cTokens and transfers underlying out
CToken.borrowFresh: increases account borrows and transfers underlying out
CToken.repayBorrowFresh: pulls underlying and decreases borrow balances
CToken.liquidateBorrowFresh: repays and seizes collateral during liquidation
CToken.seizeInternal: moves cToken balances from borrower to liquidator
CErc20Delegator._setImplementation: admin-only update of delegatecall implementation
CErc20Delegator.delegateAndReturn: forwards msg.data via delegatecall to implementation
CErc20Delegator.delegateTo: generic delegatecall helper
Unitroller fallback: raw delegatecall to comptrollerImplementation with msg.data
Comptroller.refreshCompSpeeds: recomputes per-market COMP speeds; guarded by msg.sender==tx.origin
Comptroller.claimComp: distributes accrued COMP to holders/markets
Comptroller.transferComp: performs CHEESE/COMP token transfer to user
CDaiDelegate.doTransferIn: pulls DAI and joins it into the DSR pot
CDaiDelegate.doTransferOut: exits DSR pot and sends DAI out
Cheese.delegateBySig: signature-based vote delegation with nonce and expiry
Cheese.transferFrom: ERC-20 transferFrom using msg.sender allowance
CToken.initialize: one-time market initialization restricted to admin
CToken.exchangeRateStoredInternal: computes exchange rate from cash, borrows and reserves
CToken.borrowBalanceStoredInternal: computes accrued borrow balance from snapshot
Comptroller._supportMarket: admin-only market listing
Comptroller._setMiningBuff: admin/initializing-only CHEESE mining buff update
Comptroller.updateCompSupplyIndex: accrues COMP supply index for a market
Comptroller.updateCompBorrowIndex: accrues COMP borrow index for a market
Comptroller.distributeSupplierComp: computes and transfers supplier COMP
CDaiDelegate/_becomeImplementation: admin-only implementation bootstrap performing external calls
CToken.seize: external seize entrypoint calling seizeInternal with msg.sender
CToken.liquidateBorrowInternal: accrues interest on both markets then liquidates
CToken._setPendingAdmin: admin-only pending admin update
CToken._acceptAdmin: accepts admin transfer if caller is pendingAdmin
CToken._reduceReservesFresh: admin-only reserve reduction with transfer out
Cheese.transfer: ERC-20 transfer updating balances and delegations
Cheese.approve: ERC-20 approval writing allowances[msg.sender][spender]
msg.sender: untrusted caller identity used for auth and accounting
block.timestamp (now): untrusted time value used in signature expiry
tx.origin: untrusted origin used in refreshCompSpeeds guard
delegatecall to a mutable implementation/comptroller address (storage-context external code execution)
external token transfer/transferFrom call with attacker-influenced recipient or non-standard return handling
unchecked/hand-rolled arithmetic (add/sub/mul) on balances, indices and reserves
ecrecover signature recovery on attacker-supplied v,r,s
Parameter mintAmount of mintInternal/mintFresh
Parameter redeemTokens of redeemInternal/redeemFresh
Parameter borrowAmount of borrowInternal/borrowFresh
Parameter repayAmount of repayBorrowInternal and liquidateBorrow
Parameter seizeTokens of seize/seizeInternal
Parameter liquidator in liquidateBorrowFresh/seizeInternal
Parameter borrower in liquidation and seize paths
Parameter cTokenCollateral market address in liquidateBorrow
Local borrowRateMantissa in accrueInterest returned by interestRateModel
Local simpleInterestFactor Exp used to scale accrued interest
Local allowanceNew in transferTokens
Local srcTokensNew in transferTokens
Local dstTokensNew in transferTokens
Parameter newPendingAdmin of _setPendingAdmin
Parameter reduceAmount of _reduceReserves/_reduceReservesFresh
Parameter addAmount of _addReserves/_addReservesFresh
Parameter delegatee in delegate/delegateBySig
Parameter nonce in delegateBySig
Parameter expiry in delegateBySig
Parameter implementation_ in CErc20Delegator._setImplementation
Parameter data (raw calldata) forwarded through delegatecall helpers
Parameters v, r, s of delegateBySig signature

edges.reason: mintAmount parameter is forwarded into mintFresh and drives the minted amount
msg.sender is used as the minter identity in mintInternal/mintFresh
redeemTokens parameter controls how many cTokens are redeemed in redeemFresh
msg.sender determines spender identity and infinite allowance in transferTokens
Cheese.transferFrom reads allowance of msg.sender as spender
_setPendingAdmin gates on msg.sender != admin
_acceptAdmin gates on msg.sender == pendingAdmin
_setImplementation requires msg.sender == admin before changing delegatecall target
refreshCompSpeeds requires msg.sender == tx.origin, an origin-based authorization check
delegateBySig compares block.timestamp (now) against the expiry parameter
expiry parameter is the timestamp deadline checked in delegateBySig
nonce parameter is validated against nonces[signatory] before delegation
delegatee parameter is the delegation target after signature verification
attacker-supplied v, r, s are passed to ecrecover
recovered signatory from ecrecover is used to authorize delegation in delegateBySig
transferComp performs an external CHEESE token transfer to a user-controlled address
CDaiDelegate.doTransferOut performs external DAI exit/transfer to the recipient
CDaiDelegate.doTransferIn performs external transferFrom/join of DAI into the pot
delegateAndReturn delegatecalls the mutable implementation with raw msg.data
delegateTo executes an arbitrary delegatecall to the given callee
Unitroller fallback delegatecalls comptrollerImplementation with msg.data
borrowRateMantissa local returned by the interest rate model is consumed by accrueInterest
simpleInterestFactor is computed with hand-rolled mulScalar arithmetic in accrueInterest
accrueInterest writes the newly computed totalBorrows to storage
accrueInterest writes the new borrowIndex to storage
accrueInterest checkpoints accrualBlockNumber at the current block
mintFresh increases totalSupply by mintTokens
mintFresh credits accountTokens[minter] with mintTokens
redeemFresh decreases totalSupply by redeemTokens
redeemFresh debits accountTokens[redeemer] by redeemTokens
borrowFresh increases totalBorrows by borrowAmount
borrowFresh updates accountBorrows[borrower].principal
repayBorrowFresh decreases totalBorrows by the actual repay amount
repayBorrowFresh decreases accountBorrows[borrower].principal
liquidateBorrowFresh calls seizeInternal for in-kind liquidations before completing effects
liquidateBorrowFresh makes an external seize call on a separate collateral cToken
seizeInternal adjusts accountTokens of borrower and liquidator
transferTokens updates source and destination accountTokens
transferTokens computes allowanceNew from the starting allowance
transferTokens computes srcTokensNew with subUInt
transferTokens computes dstTokensNew with addUInt
allowanceNew is derived from unchecked-style subUInt arithmetic
srcTokensNew is derived from subUInt arithmetic
dstTokensNew is derived from addUInt arithmetic
_notEntered flag guards transferTokens via nonReentrant
_notEntered flag guards mintInternal via nonReentrant
_notEntered flag guards redeemInternal via nonReentrant
_notEntered flag guards borrowInternal via nonReentrant
_notEntered flag guards repayBorrowInternal via nonReentrant
_notEntered flag guards the external seize path before seizeInternal
admin state variable is the authority compared against msg.sender in _setImplementation
admin state variable gates _setPendingAdmin
admin state variable is updated by _acceptAdmin acceptance
admin state variable gates _reduceReservesFresh
comptrollerImplementation is the delegatecall target in the Unitroller fallback
implementation state variable is the delegatecall target of delegateAndReturn
_setImplementation writes the new delegatecall implementation address
compAccrued balance is passed into transferComp for payout
compRate drives the supply index accrual ratio
compRate drives the borrow index accrual ratio
miningRule selects the supply- or borrow-based COMP speed computation
_setMiningBuff is gated by adminOrInitializing using msg.sender
claimComp calls distributeSupplierComp for suppliers
claimComp updates borrow indices before distributing borrower COMP
distributeSupplierComp forwards accrued COMP to transferComp
implementation_ parameter becomes the new delegatecall target under admin control
data parameter is the raw payload forwarded to the implementation via delegatecall
liquidator parameter receives seized collateral in liquidateBorrowFresh
borrower parameter identifies whose debt is repaid and collateral seized
cTokenCollateral parameter is an external contract address that is called during liquidation
repayAmount parameter bounds the liquidation repayment
seizeTokens parameter controls how much collateral balance moves
borrowAmount parameter drives the new borrow balance and transfer out
newPendingAdmin parameter is stored as the pending administrator
reduceAmount parameter controls the reserve amount transferred out to admin
_becomeImplementation requires msg.sender == admin before performing privileged external calls
Cheese.transferFrom updates the balances mapping
Cheese.transferFrom decrements the spender allowance
delegateBySig increments nonces[signatory] for replay protection
Cheese.transfer updates the balances mapping of source and destination
Cheese.approve writes allowances[msg.sender][spender]

normalization_plan.reason: mintAmount is a transient parameter that only exists to feed mintFresh
redeemTokens is a transient parameter consumed exclusively by redeemFresh
borrowAmount only parameterizes borrowFresh accounting
repayAmount flows through liquidation into repayBorrowFresh
seizeTokens only parameterizes the internal balance move
liquidator is only a destination for seized collateral
borrower identifies the account touched by liquidation logic
cTokenCollateral is an external contract address used by liquidation
borrowRateMantissa is a scratch value inside accrueInterest
simpleInterestFactor is an intermediate value of accrueInterest
allowanceNew is a scratch allowance value inside transferTokens
srcTokensNew is a scratch balance value inside transferTokens
dstTokensNew is a scratch balance value inside transferTokens
newPendingAdmin is only stored by _setPendingAdmin
reduceAmount is only consumed by _reduceReservesFresh
addAmount is added into totalReserves with checked arithmetic
delegatee is only used as the delegation target
nonce is only validated against Cheese nonces
expiry is only compared against block.timestamp
implementation_ is only assigned to the implementation slot
data is the raw payload passed to the delegatecall
v, r, s are only consumed by ecrecover
